run.name: Amentum Holdings, Inc.
run.title: CP-OS host session (AMTM)
run.summary: Amentum Holdings, Inc. has sound liquidity of USD 1,376 million and net leverage of 3.03x, down from 3.23x, supported by U.S. Government revenue; thin cash conversion and untested loan terms limit the view. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context.

revenue.basis: Revenues, as the CP-1 table prints it.

ebitda.basis: EBITDA, company definition before adjustments, as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Principal debt 3,875 (Q3 10-Q page:10), cash 459 (page:2), LTM Adjusted EBITDA 1,128 (Q3 release page:10). Net figure matches management's stated 3.0x. LTM spans 53 weeks.

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. LTM Adjusted EBITDA 1,128 over LTM interest paid 287 (306 plus 175 less 194; Q3 10-Q page:5). The LTM includes the lower April 2026 margins only from April 24, 2026.

cash.basis: Cash. Cash from Q3 10-Q page:2. Capacity 917 net of 83 of letters of credit on the 1,000 revolver, nothing borrowed (page:12). Cash includes 123 held in consolidated joint ventures (page:13), which may not be freely available to the group.

cashflow.basis: Net cash provided by operating activities, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: The credit agreement, its April 2026 amendment, ratings and current ownership are not in the sources, so covenant and creditor-control conclusions are provisional.
CP-1 main limitation: Adjusted EBITDA is a management measure, and the post-amendment covenant level and credit agreement terms are not in the sources.
